passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to look toward the Ammonites.
The Ammonites were a nation near Israel.
He told me to speak a prophecy against them.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Tell the Ammonites to hear the word of the Lord GOD, for this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you exclaimed, “Aha!” when My sanctuary was profaned, when the land of Israel was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile, therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the Ammonites.
The Ammonites were a nation near Israel.
God said, “Hear the word of the Lord GOD.”
God said, “You, Ammonites, rejoiced when My sanctuary was profaned.”
God’s sanctuary was His holy temple.
The Ammonites said, ‘Aha!’ when the temple was defiled.
God said, “You rejoiced when the land of Israel became desolate.”
The land of Israel was laid waste.
God said, “You rejoiced when the house of Judah went into exile.”
The people of Judah were taken away from their land.
God said, “Because you did this, I will give you to the people of the East.”
The people of the East will take your land as their possession.
They will set up their camps among you.
They will pitch their tents in your land.
They will eat your fruit.
They will drink your milk.
passages.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֡ה יַעַן֩ אָמְרֵ֨ךְ הֶאָ֜ח אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֣י כִֽי־ נִחָ֗ל וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּ֣י נָשַׁ֔מָּה וְאֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֥י הָלְכ֖וּ בַּגּוֹלָֽה׃ לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נֹתְנָ֨ךְ לִבְנֵי־ קֶ֜דֶם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֗ה וְיִשְּׁב֤וּ טִירֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְנָ֥תְנוּ בָ֖ךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הֵ֚מָּה יֹאכְל֣וּ פִרְיֵ֔ךְ וְהֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁתּ֥וּ חֲלָבֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and Ammon a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord spoke to Ezekiel.
The Lord is the God of Israel.
The Lord said He will act against the Ammonites.
Rabbah is the main city of the Ammonites.
The Lord will make Rabbah a pasture for camels.
The Lord will make the land of Ammon a resting place for sheep.
The Lord will do this to show His power.
The people will know that the Lord is God.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ רַבָּה֙ לִנְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְמִרְבַּץ־ צֹ֑אן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you clapped your hands and stomped your feet and rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of contempt, therefore I will indeed stretch out My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses the people who showed contempt for Israel.
You clapped your hands.
You stomped your feet.
You rejoiced over the land of Israel.
Your heart was full of contempt.
Therefore, I will act against you.
I will stretch out My hand against you.
I will give you as plunder to the nations.
I will cut you off from the peoples.
I will exterminate you from the countries.
I will destroy you.
You will know that I am the LORD.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן מַחְאֲךָ֣ יָ֔ד וְרַקְעֲךָ֖ בְּרָ֑גֶל וַתִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּכָל־ שָֽׁאטְךָ֙ בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ אֶל־ אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֤יךָֽ־ לְבַג לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךָ מִן־ הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,” therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim—the glory of the land.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the one true God.
He says this about Moab and Seir.
Moab and Seir spoke against Judah.
They said, “Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations.”
They treated Judah as if it was not special.
Because of this, the Lord will act.
He will expose the side of Moab.
He will begin with Moab’s frontier cities.
These cities are Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.
These cities are the glory of the land.
The Lord will uncover and humble Moab through these cities.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֗עַן אֲמֹ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ וְשֵׂעִ֔יר הִנֵּ֥ה כְּכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃ לָכֵן֩ הִנְנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־ כֶּ֤תֶף מוֹאָב֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים מֵֽעָרָ֖יו מִקָּצֵ֑הוּ צְבִ֗י אֶ֚רֶץ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁימֹ֔ת בַּ֥עַל מְע֖וֹן וְקִרְיָתְמָה׃

passages.text: I will give it along with the Ammonites as a possession to the people of the East, so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He will give the land and the Ammonites to the people of the East.
The people of the East will possess them.
The Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations.
passages.original: לִבְנֵי־ קֶ֙דֶם֙ עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּנְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן לֹֽא־ תִזָּכֵ֥ר בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD will judge Moab.
The Lord GOD will punish Moab for their actions.
Moab will experience these judgments.
Moab will learn that the Lord is God.
passages.original: וּבְמוֹאָ֖ב אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה שְׁפָטִ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah, and in so doing incurred grievous guilt, therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the ruler over all.
He says these words about Edom.
Edom acted with vengeance against the house of Judah.
Edom took revenge on Judah.
Edom became guilty by doing this.
The Lord GOD says:
I will stretch out My hand against Edom.
I will cut off man and beast from Edom.
No people or animals will remain there.
I will make Edom a wasteland.
This wasteland will reach from Teman to Dedan.
People in Edom will fall by the sword from Teman to Dedan.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֱד֛וֹם בִּנְקֹ֥ם נָקָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֶּאְשְׁמ֥וּ אָשׁ֖וֹם וְנִקְּמ֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃ לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְנָטִ֤תִי יָדִי֙ עַל־ אֱד֔וֹם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֣ם וּבְהֵמָ֑ה וּנְתַתִּ֤יהָ חָרְבָּה֙ מִתֵּימָ֔ן וּדְדָ֖נֶה בַּחֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ׃

passages.text: I will take My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and wrath. Then they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD is just and powerful.
Edom acted with vengeance against Judah.
Edom became guilty because of this.
The Lord GOD will punish Edom.
The Lord GOD will use His people Israel to punish Edom.
Israel will act against Edom with the Lord’s anger.
Israel will act against Edom with the Lord’s wrath.
Edom will experience the Lord’s vengeance.
Edom will know the Lord’s vengeance.
The Lord GOD has declared this.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֜י בֶּאֱד֗וֹם בְּיַד֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעָשׂ֣וּ בֶאֱד֔וֹם כְּאַפִּ֖י וְכַחֲמָתִ֑י וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, taking vengeance with malice of soul to destroy Judah with ancient hostility, therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority and power.
The Philistines acted with vengeance.
They took revenge with deep malice.
They tried to destroy Judah.
They hated Judah with ancient hostility.
The Lord GOD responds to their actions.
He says, “I am against the Philistines.”
He will stretch out His hand against them.
He will cut off the Cherethites.
He will destroy the remaining people along the coast.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בִּנְקָמָ֑ה וַיִּנָּקְמ֤וּ נָקָם֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַשְׁחִ֖ית אֵיבַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃ לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י נוֹטֶ֤ה יָדִי֙ עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת־ כְּרֵתִ֑ים וְהַ֣אֲבַדְתִּ֔י אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית ח֥וֹף הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking.
The Lord will act with power.
The Lord will bring great vengeance against these people.
The Lord will punish them with furious anger.
The Lord will correct them with strong rebuke.
The Lord will show His vengeance to them.
Then these people will know that He is the Lord.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתִי בָם֙ נְקָמ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת בְּתוֹכְח֖וֹת חֵמָ֑ה וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֥י אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃ס
